title.description: Heading of the Daily Challenge card at the top of Home — three goals a day, in different games, reset every day.

progress.description: How many of today's challenge goals are done, shown top-right of the card heading, e.g. "1 of 3 complete".
progress.notes: Shares a row with the heading — keep it short.

allDone.description: Message under the goals once every goal is done. The challenge resets each day.

goal.fallback.description: A goal chip for a goal this app version has no specific wording for: play the named game.
goal.fallback.notes: {{game}} is a localised game name such as "Solitaire". Chips wrap, but keep it compact.

goal.daily_word.completed.description: A goal chip: play today's puzzle through to the end, win or lose.
goal.daily_word.completed.notes: {{game}} is a localised game name such as "Solitaire". Chips wrap, but keep it compact.

goal.daily_word.won.description: A goal chip: win today's puzzle.
goal.daily_word.won.notes: {{game}} is a localised game name such as "Solitaire". Chips wrap, but keep it compact.

goal.daily_word.won_guesses_used_at_most.description: A goal chip: win the puzzle using no more than {{count}} guesses (of 6). Singular form ({{count}} = 1).
goal.daily_word.won_guesses_used_at_most.notes: {{game}} is a localised game name such as "Solitaire". Chips wrap, but keep it compact. Plural forms follow the i18next count rules for the language.

goal.daily_word.won_guesses_used_at_most.description: A goal chip: win the puzzle using no more than {{count}} guesses (of 6). Plural form.

goal.twenty48.final_score_at_least.description: A goal chip: reach at least the given score in one game, e.g. "Score 2500+ in 2048".
goal.twenty48.final_score_at_least.notes: {{game}} is a localised game name such as "Solitaire". Chips wrap, but keep it compact. The "+" after {{target}} means "or more"; use the natural equivalent if "+" reads oddly.

goal.doneA11y.description: Screen-reader label for a goal chip that is done. {{goal}} is the chip's visible text.

goal.todoA11y.description: Screen-reader label for a goal chip that is not done yet. {{goal}} is the chip's visible text.

loading.a11y.description: Screen-reader label for the card while today's challenge is loading.

offline.title.description: Short heading on the Daily Challenge card when the device is offline and the challenge can't be loaded.

offline.body.description: Explanation under the offline heading. Tapping the card retries.

offline.retryA11y.description: Screen-reader label for the offline card, which retries loading when tapped.
